materialization_scan.qualification: Halfword-aligned address candidates; selected coherent functions are decoded separately.

vfx_consumer.relationship_to_builder: Producer and consumer use the same record offsets/layout. A particular context instance traversing both calls in a frame/state-machine transition is not proven.

driver_links.qualification: Names are inferred from independent diagnostic-table callers, not recovered symbol exports.

remaining_gaps: Mapped IP is selected through resource/handle lookup, not a proven fixed still IP index.
Producer output and consumer input have matching layout but their per-instance lifecycle/state-machine edge remains unproven.
Capture-frame scheduling, payload validity and physical table ownership are not established.
Snapshot/context links rely on coherent direct calls and ordinary callee-saved-register ABI; no device observations.

mlut_payload_loader_constraints.alignment_precision_and_channel_order: Not established. Wrapper and descriptor builder accept an unaligned source pointer in isolated emulation.
mlut_payload_loader_constraints.completion_qualification: Separate worker and DMA-style descriptor/callback path are present. Sender return is not proof of payload consumption or frame completion; OSAL and hardware lifetime contract is unresolved.

host_microchecks.method: Isolated Thumb Unicorn execution; memory clearing, diagnostic mode and queue submission are stubbed. No on-camera execution or DMA.
host_microchecks.interpretation: Wrapper accepts unaligned source pointers at this layer; downstream hardware requirements remain unresolved.

limitations: Code/data labels are segment-role inference corroborated by examined bytes, not recovered ELF section names.
Only selected function regions are decoded; no complete function boundary or call graph recovery.
Halfword scan can find overlapping instruction candidates; selected references are corroborated in coherent routines.
0x4155 is a candidate message dispatch ID until its dispatcher and AP producer are joined.
Seven MLUT IP indices and register accesses do not identify which path carries full-resolution still images.
CamCore Create3DLUT and MLUT user-LUT facilities must not be assumed to share table encodings.
No CUBE channel order, bit precision, SRAM packing, DMA/cache ownership, capture routing, or safe runtime call established.
Compiler diagnostic and C++ RTTI establish linked-runtime clues, not exact compiler/version.
TOPPERS-FMP source-path version is an embedded build clue, not a complete RTOS provenance or patch-level attestation.
